== Original Virtual Set 11 published English card text ==
Deploy rises from 6 to 7. The remaster removes the pilot bonus and the option to treat the control phase on your Disarmed as a move phase. It adds an Episode I site deployment discount. The original once-per-turn local destiny cancellation becomes a paid action during a battle or duel with a Dark Jedi and names duel, weapon and battle destiny. Both retain the Obi-Wan’s Journal exception, Disarmed search and attrition immunity.
